description: Phase 4: Accessibility & UX fixes - ARIA labels, locale formatter, List-Unsubscribe header, manifest lang, API cache TTL, SW admin bypass, offline.html color scheme, idempotency keys
steps: 1. Add ARIA labels to AdminDashboard.jsx interactive elements in apps/frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx: Since the file is 5681 lines, add aria-label attributes to key interactive patterns. Specifically: (a) Add aria-label to the main dashboard container/section elements, (b) Add role='region' and aria-label to major card/widget wrappers that are identifiable in the first 50 lines or at component boundaries, (c) This is a targeted fix - not a full accessibility audit of 5681 lines.

2. Fix number formatter locale in apps/frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx: Change line 22 from new Intl.NumberFormat('en', ...) to use undefined (which defaults to user's locale) or use navigator.language. Change to: new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).

3. Add List-Unsubscribe header to emails in apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py: This was already partially addressed in FEAT-001 step 4. Verify the 'headers' field with 'List-Unsubscribe' is present in the _send_email JSON payload. If not already done, add it. Also add 'List-Unsubscribe-Post': 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click' for RFC 8058 compliance.

4. Fix manifest.json lang to support Assamese in apps/frontend/public/manifest.json: Change 'lang': 'en-IN' to 'lang': 'en' (generic English) since the app supports both English and Assamese. Add a 'dir': 'ltr' field. Optionally, keep en-IN but this is acceptable since the primary language is English with Assamese content.

5. Reduce API_CACHE_TTL in apps/frontend/public/sw.js from 3600s to 300s: Change the constant 'const API_CACHE_TTL = 3600 * 1000;' to 'const API_CACHE_TTL = 300 * 1000;' (5 minutes instead of 1 hour).

6. Add /staff to SW admin bypass list in apps/frontend/public/sw.js: After the existing admin bypass check (if url.pathname === '/admin' || url.pathname.startsWith('/admin/')), add a similar check for /staff: '|| url.pathname === '/staff' || url.pathname.startsWith('/staff/')'. This ensures staff dashboard pages are never served from stale SW cache.

7. Fix offline.html to respect prefers-color-scheme in apps/frontend/public/offline.html: Currently the page is hardcoded to dark mode (class='dark' on html, background #06060e). Add a @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) CSS block that changes body background to white (#ffffff), text color to dark (#1e293b), h1 color to #0f172a, p color to #64748b, and .status color to #94a3b8. Remove the hardcoded class='dark' from the html element.

8. Add idempotency keys to email sends in apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py: Generate a unique idempotency key for each email send (based on recipient + subject + timestamp truncated to minute). Add it as 'Idempotency-Key' header in the Resend API request headers. This prevents duplicate emails if the same request is retried. Use hashlib to generate a consistent key from the inputs.
acceptance_criteria: AdminDashboard main sections have aria-label attributes
Number formatter uses undefined locale (user's default) instead of hardcoded 'en'
List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers are included in all emails
SW API cache TTL is 300 seconds (5 minutes)
SW bypasses /staff and /staff/* routes (no stale cache)
offline.html renders with light theme when user prefers light color scheme
Email sends include an idempotency key to prevent duplicates
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && python -m ruff check app/services/comms/resend_client.py
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
Verify sw.js contains '/staff' bypass and API_CACHE_TTL = 300
findings: All 8 steps implemented successfully. Ruff linter passes clean. No test infrastructure needed for these static/config changes.
